Marks: 35  ____________________________________________________________________  Q.1) Take multiple files as Command Line Arguments and print their inode numbers and file types   [10 Marks ]  ans---- #include #include int main(int argc, char *argv[]) {     if (argc < 2) {         printf("Usage: %s ...\n", argv[0]);         return 1;     }     struct stat st;     for (int i = 1; i < argc; i++) {         if (stat(argv[i], &st)==-1) {             perror("Error");             continue;         }         printf("File: %s\n", argv[i]);         printf("Inode Number: %ld\n", (long)st.st_ino);         printf("File Type: ");         if (S_ISREG(st.st_mode))  printf(" Regular File\n");         else if (S_ISDIR(st.st_mode))  printf("Directory\n");         else if (S_ISLNK(st.st_mode))  printf("Symbolic Link\n");         else if (S_ISCHR(st.st_mode))  printf("Character Device\n");         else if (S_ISBLK(st.st_mode))  printf("Block Device\n");         else if (S_ISFIFO(st.st_mode)) printf("FIFO/PIPE\n");         else if (S_ISSOCK(st.st_mode)) printf("Socket\n");         else printf("Unknown\n");         printf("-------------------------\n");     }     return 0; } run---gcc Q1.c -o q1 ./q1 file1.txt file2.txt file3.txt Q.2) Write a C program to send SIGALRM signal by child process to parent process and parent process  make a provision to catch the signal and display alarm is fired.(Use Kill, fork, signal and sleep  system call)                  [20 Marks ] ans-- #include #include #include #include void alarm_handler(int sig) {     printf("Alarm is fired! (SIGALRM received)\n"); } int main() {     pid_t pid;     signal(SIGALRM, alarm_handler);  // Parent catches SIGALRM     pid = fork();     if (pid < 0) {         perror("Fork Failed");         return 1;     }     if (pid==0) {         // Child process         sleep(2);   // Wait before sending signal         printf("Child sending SIGALRM to parent...\n");         kill(getppid(), SIGALRM);     }     else {         // Parent process         printf("Parent waiting for SIGALRM...\n");         // Infinite loop until signal arrives         while (1) {             pause();  // Wait for a signal         }     }     return 0; } run---gcc Q2.c -o q2 ./q2 Q.3) Viva             [ 5 Marks ] -------------------------- Slip 1 --------------------  SAVITIBAI PHULE UNIVERSITY  M.Sc.(Computer Science) Sem-I  Practical Examination (From 2023-2024)  SUBJECT: CS-504-MJP: Lab Course on CS-501-MJ (Advanced Operating System)  Time: 3 Hours                 Max. Killing child...\n");     kill(child_pid, SIGKILL); } int main() {     signal(SIGCHLD, child_exit_handler);     signal(SIGALRM, alarm_handler);     child_pid = fork();     if (child_pid < 0) {         perror("fork");         exit(1);     }     if (child_pid==0) {         // Child process: execute a UNIX/Linux command         printf("Child executing command: sleep 10\n");         execlp("sleep", "sleep" , "10" , NULL);         // If execlp fails:         perror("execlp");         exit(1);     }     else {         // Parent         printf("Parent: Started child with PID %d\n", child_pid);         alarm(5);  // Set 5-second timer         // Parent waits for child or kill event         pause();         pause();  // Ensure all signals are handled     }     return 0; } run===sleep 10 kill(child_pid, SIGKILL); Q.3) Viva           [ 5 Marks ] -------------------------- Slip 3 --------------------  SAVITIBAI PHULE UNIVERSITY  M.Sc.(Computer Science) Sem-I  Practical Examination (From 2023-2024)  SUBJECT: CS-504-MJP: Lab Course on CS-501-MJ (Advanced Operating System)  Time: 3 Hours                 Max. Marks: 35  ____________________________________________________________________  Q.1) Write a C program to find whether a given files passed through command line arguments are  present in current directory or not.         [10 Marks ]  ans===#include #include #include int main(int argc, char *argv[]) {     if (argc < 2) {         printf("Usage: %s ...\n", argv[0]);         return 1;     }     DIR *dir = opendir(".");     if (dir == NULL) {         perror("opendir");         return 1;     }     struct dirent *entry;     // For each file given in command line     for (int i = 1; i < argc; i++) {         int found=0;         rewinddir(dir);  // Reset directory pointer         while ((entry=readdir(dir)) !=NULL) {             if (strcmp(entry-> d_name, argv[i]) == 0) {                 found = 1;                 break;             }         }         if (found)             printf("%s --> Present in current directory\n", argv[i]);         else             printf("%s --> NOT found in current directory\n", argv[i]);     }     closedir(dir);     return 0; } run ==gcc Q1.c -o q1 ./q1 file1.txt file2.c file3.pdf Q.2) Write a C program which creates a child process and child process catches a signal SIGHUP,  SIGINT and SIGQUIT. The Parent process send a SIGHUP or SIGINT signal after every 3  seconds, at the end of 15 second parent send SIGQUIT signal to child and child terminates by  displaying message "My Papa has Killed me!!!”.       ans== #include #include #include #include void sighup_handler(int sig) {     printf("Child: I received SIGHUP signal.\n"); } void sigint_handler(int sig) {     printf("Child: I received SIGINT signal.\n"); } void sigquit_handler(int sig) {     printf("My Papa has Killed me!!!\n");     exit(0); } int main() {     pid_t pid = fork();     if (pid < 0) {         perror("fork");         exit(1);     }     if (pid==0) {         // ---------------- CHILD PROCESS ----------------         signal(SIGHUP, sighup_handler);         signal(SIGINT, sigint_handler);         signal(SIGQUIT, sigquit_handler);         // Child waits forever for signals         while (1)             pause();     }     else {         // ---------------- PARENT PROCESS ----------------         printf("Parent: Child PID=%d\n", pid);         sleep(3);         kill(pid, SIGHUP);         sleep(3);         kill(pid, SIGINT);         sleep(3);         kill(pid, SIGHUP);         sleep(3);         kill(pid, SIGINT);         // After total 15 seconds → send SIGQUIT         sleep(3);         kill(pid, SIGQUIT);         printf("Parent: Sent SIGQUIT. Child should terminate now.\n");     }     return 0; } run==Child: I received SIGHUP signal. Child: I received SIGINT signal. Child: I received SIGHUP signal. Child: I received SIGINT signal. The child process will write following three  messages to pipe and parent process display it.   Message1 = “Hello World”   Message2 = “Hello SPPU”   Message3 = “Linux is Funny”       ==== #include #include #include #include int main() {     int fd[2];     pid_t pid;     char buffer[100];     if (pipe(fd) == -1) {         perror("pipe");         return 1;     }     pid = fork();     if (pid < 0) {         perror("fork");         return 1;     }     if (pid==0) {         // Child process writes messages         close(fd[0]); // Close read end         char *messages[]={             "Hello World\n" ,             "Hello SPPU\n" ,             "Linux is Funny\n"         };         for (int i=0; i < 3; i++) {             write(fd[1], messages[i], strlen(messages[i]));         }         close(fd[1]);         exit(0);     } else {         // Parent process reads messages         close(fd[1]); // Close write end         int n;         while ((n=read(fd[0], buffer, sizeof(buffer)-1))> 0) {             buffer[n] = '\0'; // Null terminate             printf("%s", buffer);         }         close(fd[0]);         wait(NULL); // Wait for child to finish     }     return 0; } ==== gcc Q1.c -o q1 ./q1 gcc Q2.c -o q2 ./q2 [20 Marks ]  Q.3) Viva   [ 5 Marks ] -------------------------- Slip 18 --------------------  SAVITIBAI PHULE UNIVERSITY  M.Sc.(Computer Science) Sem-I  Practical Examination (From 2023-2024)  SUBJECT: CS-504-MJP: Lab Course on CS-501-MJ (Advanced Operating System)  Time: 3 Hours                 Max.         sleep(2);         printf("Child will be suspended for 5 seconds...\n");         kill(getpid(), SIGSTOP); // Suspend itself         // Resumed after SIGCONT         printf("Child resumed!\n");         sleep(2);         printf("Child finished execution.\n");         exit(0);     } else {         // Parent process         sleep(3); // Wait for child to suspend itself         printf("Parent resuming child...\n");
